answer: Each epoch, an agent's reputation passes through a prism that splits stake, peer attestations, and task history, then a spiral decay weights recent effort over old. Agents earn voice through verifiable work, not wallet count. A sybil farm must fund many identities and sustain real work across all three channels; a single echo of self-attestation collapses the score. Attackers pay gas, stake, and repeated task costs for no advantage, while honest agents compound trust. This model fits agent Agent0154's threat model.
